findings.detail: Bash 6596 against Edit plus Write 1661, a ratio of 4.0. Under bypass permissions the harness tells agents to prefer heredocs and sed.
findings.action: Any hook matching only Edit|Write is decorative here. Include Bash in the matcher, or use permissions.deny, which is tool-agnostic.

findings.detail: 15 of 1979 transcripts carry a compaction marker, and 13 of 104 large ones.
findings.action: Compaction is not the durability axis on this machine. Do not build anti-drift mechanisms around surviving it.

findings.detail: 12 installed commands or skills have never been invoked: check_coding_conventions, check_plan, check_project_structure, code_formatting, create_PR, create_plan, draft_git_commit_message, goldfish, gpu-util, push_all_changes_to_git, show_filetree_with_edits, thoroughly_test
findings.action: A command must be typed. A skill can be invoked by the model when its description matches. Convert what should fire automatically into a skill and write the description for the task, not for the file. Delete the rest.

findings.detail: Agent output runs 19.9 em dashes per thousand words over the last 14 days. Roald asked for zero.
findings.action: The style rules are not reaching the surface that produces this. Check whether the write-external skill and the steering output style are installed and firing.
